# LOoz.design

> LOoz.design is a one-person freelance studio building custom websites & e-commerce,
> process automation, and AI agents for small businesses and solo founders. Italian market
> first, with English and Swedish mirrored. Remote studio based in Europe, with clients in
> Italy and Sweden.

LOoz.design sells outcomes, not hours: fast custom websites built to turn visitors into
customers, automations that absorb repetitive work (email, invoices, reports), and tailored
AI agents for people who run their business alone. Client guarantees: the code, accounts and
domain stay in the client's name (no lock-in), price is agreed upfront, replies within 24
hours, work in Italian, English and Swedish. A custom website ships in a few weeks; an
automation or AI agent in days.

## Pages

- [Home](https://looz.design/): Services (websites & e-commerce, online visibility/SEO, social content, automation, web data, AI agents), guarantees, FAQ and a free website audit.
- [Work](https://looz.design/work): Fourteen demo projects showing style and range, each with a live demo and a project page.
- [Process](https://looz.design/processo): The four-phase method — listen, strategy, build, launch & growth.
- [AI assistant](https://looz.design/agents): A live multilingual (IT/EN/SV) AI assistant that answers questions about services, projects and pricing — itself an example of the agents the studio builds.
- [Contact](https://looz.design/contatti): Written brief or a 20-minute discovery call, confirmed within 24 hours.

## Selected projects

- [Aliva](https://looz.design/work/aliva): Immersive scroll story for a Calabrian extra-virgin olive oil, plus full brand identity.
- [YogaPlus](https://looz.design/work/yoga): Complete yoga-studio site with courses, shop, booking and blog.
- [Golden Dragon](https://looz.design/work/sushi): Japanese-Korean fusion restaurant in Milan with booking, delivery and gift cards.
- [Artigiano Gelateria](https://looz.design/work/gelateria): Artisan gelateria with online pickup booking and owner admin panel.
- [AI Visibility](https://looz.design/work/ai-visibility): Demo of an AI-search-visibility product tracking brand citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude.
- [Bella Calabria](https://looz.design/work/bella-calabria): Travel booking portal with Airbnb-style booking and admin dashboard.
- [Barberia](https://looz.design/work/barberia): Barbershop site with online booking that cuts phone calls.
- [Atelier Solari](https://looz.design/work/fotografo): Multilingual wedding-photography studio for Tuscany and the Amalfi Coast.

All projects are independent concept/demo builds made for the portfolio; any third-party
brands shown belong to their respective owners and are not affiliated with the studio.
